title: Myelodysplastic syndromes are propagated by rare and distinct human cancer stem cells in vivo
description: Gene expression analysis of purified hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells isolated from low to intermediate risk MDS patients and age-matched normal healthy controls. Overall design: Analysis of lineage associated genes and PCA clustering of populations
